{{Top|leg}}
'''Gree Park''' was a park located in the [[Ussa]], the capital city of [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. [[Roan Lands]], while under close watch from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]], managed to lose them for a while in Gree Park, in the midst of the hiking trails that the park sported.
